posts.community: Harshdeep Hortico Ltd (SME) - A Microcap Opportunity in India's Growing Gardening & Outdoor Lifestyle Market
posts.text: @RoyD I agree that working capital and cash conversion are important areas to watch. However, I think it is worth looking at the current cash flow situation in the context of where the company is in its growth journey. Harshdeep is still a relatively young listed company that is investing for growth. Over the last few years, it has expanded its manufacturing capacity, increased its product portfolio, entered new categories such as outdoor furniture and shade nets, strengthened exports, and expanded its distribution network.
